evals.prompt: Create an extension that offsets only selected editable local meshes by a user distance, with a panel, one undo step and clean disable/re-enable. Work in a disposable project; do not install globally or publish.
evals.expected_output: Produces owned package resources, explicit operator scope and data assertions for selected/unselected meshes; actual lifecycle tests distinguished from unexecuted UI checks.
assertions: Editable/source selection remains scoped and unrelated objects unchanged.
Undo/redo assertions examine transforms rather than operator status alone.

evals.prompt: An existing extension registers two classes and a menu, then fails while adding a property. It also leaves a modal timer after Escape. Diagnose and repair lifecycle behavior without deleting user data.
evals.expected_output: Acquisition-aware rollback and every terminal modal path release only owned resources; a forced-failure fixture demonstrates cleanup or is explicitly unexecuted.
assertions: Partially acquired resources unwind in reverse dependency order.
Cancellation removes timer/draw resources and states what partial data is retained/restored.
No foreign registration, preferences or file is deleted to make the test pass.
